definitions.explanation: The prevailing feeling or mood of a place.

examples.japanese: {気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
examples.english: It's fun when you have friends you get along with.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{気|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦すぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: He worries too much about others and is always tired.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{休|やす}まる→休まる：27811_yasumaru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}みたい→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I'm so busy that I have no time to relax, so I want to take it easy on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦{変|へん}な→変：01124_hen⟧{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦どこか→どこか：02361_dokoka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I feel like we've met somewhere before, but I can't remember.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦すぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{気|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なれなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I was so tired that I couldn't bring myself to eat anything.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちていた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I was feeling down after losing the match, but my friend's words cheered me up.
This place has a nice atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不思議|ふしぎ}な→不思議：02358_fushigi⟧{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っている→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: A mysterious air hangs over the place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{神聖|しんせい}な→神聖：13735_shinsei⟧{気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{感|かん}じられる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。

examples.english: The air at the mountain peak is clear and very refreshing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}な→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧{気|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{満|み}ちていて→満ちる：02428_michiru⟧、⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}く→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: This forest is filled with a special atmosphere, and just walking through it calms the mind.

notes:
{気|き} is one of the most versatile words in Japanese. It combines with many verbs and nouns to express mental states, feelings, and atmosphere.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (MIND/ATTENTION):
- {気|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to be careful, to pay attention
- {気|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be on one's mind, to be concerned about
- {気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a feeling (that ~)
- {気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change one's mind
- {気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to get along well
- {気|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to be considerate, to worry about others
- {気|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: to not worry about it

COMMON EXPRESSIONS (MOOD/INCLINATION):
- {気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}まない→進む：01225_susumu⟧: to not feel like doing something
- 〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{気|き}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to feel like doing ~
- {気|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧: to feel satisfied

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧: energy, health
- ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧: weather
- ⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧: feeling
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧: popularity
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧: air, atmosphere
